title: Force Of Will
about: A track about internal strength, determination, and moving forward without needing motivation.
description: Force Of Will centers on the idea that action doesn’t come from emotion or external pressure, but from decision. It highlights resilience under weight, pushing forward without hesitation, and choosing direction regardless of obstacles. The track presents strength as something constant and controlled, not dependent on circumstances.
lyrics: verse 1
i don’t break when it gets heavy
that’s the moment i lean in
weight doesn’t slow me down
it reminds me who i’ve been
every doubt just feeds the fire
every wall becomes a test
i don’t ask if i can do it
i decide — and handle the rest
pre-chorus
you can push, you can pull
you can try to bend me still
but you cant break my force of will
chorus
this is strength you don’t see coming
this is pressure that won’t yield
i don’t stop, i don’t question
i decide — and it is real
no hesitation, no permission
no dependence
i don’t run on motivation
i run on force of will
verse 2
i’ve been quiet, i’ve been patient
i’ve been watching every move
while they talk about their limits

nothing given, nothing borrowed
everything i am is built
you can try to take it from me
but you’ll choke on my force of will
bridge
i don’t need a reason

final chorus
this is strength that doesn’t fracture
